rules.start: B=recorded EC start actual pose;recorded actual v,w;exact check snapshot only;missing maps excluded with counts
rules.termination: Brake request at earlier path endpoint recognition or2.0s;latched stop_command until v=0,w=0
rules.clock: 72Hz integration,9Hz control. Continuation keeps absolute phase;2s brake request applied at next9Hz tick (0 or4 extra ticks on these logs),all held-motion ticks checked
rules.replay: Original INSTALL checks rebuild fresh frozen NA profile;continuation restores installed generation and recorded control-state evolution before check;regression matches pass,duration,endpoint,clearance<=1e-6m
rules.tail_comparison: All recorded checks;confirmed PASS->REJECT requires original replay match. Mismatches separated,not claimed as tail effects
rules.graph: Reduced SE(2) execution graph:14 XY variables (B+7 future points);all72Hz SE(2) states eliminated through frozen PP/SP integrate_se2 equality factors;no independent yaw/time variables
rules.graph_reference: Each of8 current stored NoMaD candidates separately:project B,connect B to suffix,re-sample8 arc-length points;B fixed;no0.25m short cutoff,degenerate suffix reported
rules.objective: sum_i ||p_i-q_candidate_i||^2 only;unit weight,no extra sigma or tuning
rules.bounds: Each future XY coordinate within +/-0.75m of its own initial reference
rules.execution_constraint: Minimum continuous circular-footprint clearance on PP/SP72Hz trajectory including braking tail >=0.025m;terminal v=w=0 by construction
rules.graph_clock: New-path INSTALL EC semantics:initial PP control at t=0,then9Hz;actual initial pose/v/w from check. No replanning delay,NoMaD regeneration or depth update simulated
rules.acceleration: Compiled arithmetic mirror with exact arc/site clearance clipped only above+0.075m;no fast-math;geometry-equivalent .025 feasible set;tested vs Python
rules.acceptance: Solver success + numerical violation<=1e-7 + independent Python braking-tail EC >=.025 and terminal stop;reject independent failures
rules.infeasible_boundary: If fixed initial footprint itself fails exact.025 clearance,all8 starts proven infeasible without SLSQP;count as no solution and record reason
rules.dedup: Unique(run,tick,pose,v,w,snapshot frame/file,current candidate bank id,cap). Original REJECT only;full-speed inputs solved once;0.1m/s unique inputs counted but never solved
rules.candidate_selection: Lowest objective among independently verified8 solutions,tie sample index. Report original-candidate tail PASS and solved-only rescue separately
rules.timing: Four independent event workers,BLAS1. Per-event time includes8 starts and independent checks;map loading/startup separate. Per-start timing also reported
rules.limitations: Same historical data;offline feasibility only. Distance-only objective can shorten/stop or rotate without progress:travel and <=5cm motion reported. No oracle used for solve/certificate
